## Membership Benefits
Membership provides access to a nationwide professional network dedicated to technical excellence, continuing professional development, knowledge sharing, publications, networking opportunities, leadership roles, and collaborative initiatives.

## Membership Categories

1. Life Membership
2. Student Membership
3. Institutional Membership

See details of the [membership categories](membership/categories.qmd).

## Applying for Membership

1. Choose your desired [membership category](membership/categories.qmd) and download the appropriate application form.
2. There are two ways to fill the form
    1. Fill the form electronically, insert your photograph and signature and save it in PDF format using your favourite PDF editing application (suggestion: [BentoPDF](https://www.bentopdf.com/edit-pdf)), **or**
    2. Print the blank application form, fill it by hand, affix your photograph and put your signature. Scan the filled application form and save it in PDF format.
4. Pay the required fees in any one of the following ways:
    1. **UPI:** Scan the QR code using any UPI app and complete the payment. Please note down the UPI transaction ID for future reference.
    2. **Bank Transfer:** Transfer the required amount to the following bank account and note down the transaction ID for future reference.
5. Scan the following documents and save them in a single PDF file:
    1. Your masters degree certificate
    2. Your Aadhar card
    3. Proof of payment of membership fee
 6. Email the following PDF files prepared as above to sea-indiaSend the application form in PDF format along with the PDF file
